title: Sweep: disposition defect ledger (3 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Disposition + defect-ledger prescriptions: schema examples, DEFERRED reason echoing, ledger fidelity. Adjacent to ADR-0092. Amortised from 3 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.
